messages:
ryan: Heads-up — did a regional latency/throughput sweep for nightly bursts. Trying a slotting strategy for hetero pools (H100 + A100). Short summary: p95 delta H100-FP16 vs A100-FP16 ≈ 18ms on 2k-token requests; A100 shows p99 spikes when concurrency >= 8/card. Proposal: cap concurrency 6 on A100, 12 on H100, and enable autoscale burst slots of +20% in ap-southeast overnight. :eyes:

maya: Can you paste the microbench numbers? need p50/p95/p99 and tokens/sec and the quant runs (q4f16 / q8h). Also which kernel choices you used for H100 (cuBLAS/flash) and A100 (default/cublas-optimized).

ryan: Attaching the trimmed CSV I used (pulled from bench-runner). Note these are median of 5 runs, mixed frontend load.

ryan: ```
region,gpu,model,quant,concurrency,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,tokens_s
ap-southeast,h100,redwood-65b,fp16,12,34,58,72,860
ap-southeast,h100,redwood-65b,q4f16,12,30,52,67,920
ap-southeast,a100,redwood-65b,fp16,6,48,76,140,640
ap-southeast,a100,redwood-65b,q4f16,6,44,70,120,700
eu-west,h100,redwood-30b,fp16,12,28,46,62,1100
eu-west,a100,redwood-30b,fp16,6,42,68,115,780
```

ryan: Kernel notes: H100 ran with flash-attn+cutlass kernels; A100 used cuBLAS fused kernels (we saw best throughput at lower concurrency with fused).

dan: Quick note: q4f16 gives ~5-8% token/sec improvement and small latency win, but eval CI flagged a quality regression on the long-summary set for the 65b family. We should gate q4f16 on sensitive routes. Link to failing prompts: https://internal/bench/3160000000/regressions (private).

sophia: Confirming — on the summarization eval suite q4f16 (65b) shows average ROUGE drop ~1.8 and perplexity +1.7 on long-context tests. Recommendation: canary q4f16 only on H100 (where it performs best) and keep A100 runs fp16 unless explicitly canaried. Also suggest fallback to fp16 for requests > 4096 tokens.

infra-bot: autoscaler: burst policy applied to pool-asia-hetero at 02:00 UTC — +22% capacity for 30m (trigger: predicted nightly surge).

ryan: Decision draft: slot by GPU class — reserve ~30% of A100 cards for low-concurrency/sensitive routes, enable q4f16 by default only on H100 pools, and run A100 q4f16 as canary in dedicated low-traffic pools with automatic fallback to fp16 on latency/quality regressions. Change autoscale policy to min= baseline, burst=+25% but cap burst-duration to 30m. Who can own the rollout?

maya: I can own the rollout. I'll push canary tomorrow 03:00 UTC, monitor p50/p95/p99 and the eval dashboard for the long-summary set. Will add runbook steps and rollback criteria (p99 > baseline + 30ms OR eval ROUGE drop > 1%).

dan: Command I'll use to watch histograms during canary: `./tools/peek-latency --pool pool-asia-hetero --since 1h --percentiles 50,95,99`

sophia: Also please wire the eval/regressions-dashboard to the canary job and add an alert: if eval-quality drops >1% within the canary window, trigger rollback + page.

ryan: :thumbsup: Thanks — let's sync after the first canary run and decide on slot percentages and final concurrency caps.
